meaning:
λοιδορία, -ας, ἡ
(λοιδορέω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב, מְרִיבָה ;]
abuse, railing: 1Ti.5:14, 1Pe.3:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
